status: Upstream standalone reference only; no application integration
adapterVerification: Actual demo requestAdapter result reports nvidia / blackwell / isFallbackAdapter false. Device/description are privacy-redacted. The sole NVIDIA DXGI adapter is the GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU; AMD 860M is not the selected WebGPU vendor.

method.launch: Installed Chrome, temporary profile, scripts/chrome-gpu.mjs high-performance/DXGI flags

method.camera: Unmodified upstream initial camera; no navigation during sampling
method.warmup: 4 seconds after the HUD first reports FPS
method.sampling: 10 HUD text samples at 1-second intervals for each case
method.timing: Upstream smoothed GPU timestamp interval: first compute pass through final composite; includes ocean simulation/rendering/sky/postprocessing
method.screenshot: After sampling; not included in collected timing samples

limits: Short isolated upstream ocean views, no Terrain Studio terrain, foliage, shoreline, depth/refraction integration or editor work.
